aboutPage.p1: FLUENTSTELLAR is designed for active vocabulary practice, not passive browsing.
aboutPage.p2: You do not scroll through word lists or memorize definitions. You practice words by using them, through carefully designed exercises that train recall, spelling, and recognition.
aboutPage.p3: There is no registration and no login. You choose your native language, the language you want to practice, and your CEFR level. If you do not know your level, a short test helps determine it.
aboutPage.p4: Then you start a practice session.
aboutPage.p5: All learning happens inside the session. Words are introduced, tested, repeated, and reinforced through different exercises, not shown as lists.
aboutPage.howSubtitle: The system uses multiple exercise types, such as:
aboutPage.p6: Some exercises train active recall, others provide light reinforcement. Words are counted only when you correctly recall them, revealing an answer does not count as learning.
aboutPage.p7: This approach focuses on real vocabulary acquisition, not shortcuts.
aboutPage.p8: You can start practicing immediately, without creating an account or sharing personal data. Nothing is stored after you leave the session.
aboutPage.goalText: practice words effectively, with as little friction as possible.

step1.title: Step 1: Choose languages
step1.item2: the language you want to practice

step2.title: Step 2: Set filters (optional)
step2.note2: By default, all filters are active.
step2.note3: If you do not select anything, it means you practice all levels, all topics, and all word types.

step3.title: Step 3: Choose exercises
step3.intro: Go to the exercise selection page and choose which exercise types you want to practice.
step3.note: By default, all exercises are selected.

step4.title: Step 4: Choose session size (optional)
step4.intro: You can choose how many words you want to practice in the session.
step4.item1: You can set a word quantity
step4.item2: Or start practicing without a limit and finish the session at any time

fullWord.title: 1) Full word typing
fullWord.goal: Goal: Type the correct word in the language you are practicing.
fullWord.seeInput: An input field where you type the answer

halfWritten.title: 2) Half-written word typing
halfWritten.goal: Goal: Complete a partially written word in the language you are practicing.
halfWritten.seePartial: The target word shown partially written (you must type the missing part)
halfWritten.seeInput: An input field for completing the missing letters
halfWritten.note: This exercise has no Hint button, because part of the word is already provided.

brokenWord.title: 3) Broken-word assembling
brokenWord.goal: Goal: Assemble the correct word by placing word parts in the correct order.
brokenWord.seeSlots: Empty slots for the word parts
brokenWord.seeChunks: A set of shuffled word parts that you place into the slots

connectWords.title: 4) Word connection
connectWords.goal: Goal: Connect words in the practicing language with their meanings in your native language.
connectWords.seeTypeTop: Word type (part of speech) at the top (applies to all items)
connectWords.seeLeft: Left side: 4 words in the language you are practicing
connectWords.seeRight: Right side: 4 meanings in your native language
connectWords.how1: Tap one item on the left, then tap the matching item on the right
connectWords.how3: Incorrect matches are highlighted briefly and can be retried

listening.title: 5) Listening exercise
listening.goal: Goal: Match spoken words in the practicing language with their meanings in your native language.
listening.seeTypeTop: Word type (part of speech) at the top (applies to all items)
listening.seeLeft: Left side: 4 audio buttons (microphone) for words in the practicing language
listening.seeRight: Right side: 4 meanings in your native language
listening.how1: Tap an audio button to hear a word
listening.how2: Then connect it to the correct meaning on the right
listening.how4: Incorrect matches are highlighted briefly and can be retried
listening.note: There are no hints and no "show me word" here.

common.seeMeaning: The word meaning in your native language
common.seeMeta: Word metadata: CEFR level, topic, and word type (part of speech)

finish.title: Skipping and finishing
finish.p1: Every exercise includes a Skip button.
finish.p2: You can finish the session at any time.
finish.p3: Words are counted only when you recall them correctly (revealing a word does not count as a successful recall).
